sample_unit: LLM-generated responses to 26 FAQs, rated by 5 experts

links.outcome: Readability and complexity of LLM responses to caregiver questions
links.effect: Google SGE gave the most readable responses; ChatGPT answered with the most complexity. No numeric reading levels reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Google SGE generated the most readable responses whereas ChatGPT answered with the most complexity.

links.outcome: Frequency of AI disclosure in LLM responses to caregivers
links.effect: AI disclosure was less frequent in ChatGPT responses; Bard balanced AI disclosure with clarity. No numbers reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Regarding the disclosure of responses being generated by AI, it was observed less frequently in ChatGPT responses, which may have affected the clarity of responses, whereas Bard maintained a balance between AI disclosure and response clarity.

screen.reason: The study evaluates four LLM tools answering FAQs for caregivers of pediatric cancer patients, with responses rated offline by expert clinicians. It evaluates model accuracy, readability, and disclosure frequencies across models but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
